```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

The purpose of this vignette is to display all high-level plots available in `GGally` to be used in particular with `ggduo()` and `ggpairs()`. The name of all the corresponding functions are of the form `ggally_*()`. Most of them accept a discrete variables to be passed to the **colour** aesthetic.

We can distinct **bivariate plots** requiring two variables for **x** and **y** axis respectively and **diagonal plots** when the same variable is plotted on **x** and **y** axis.

```{r}
library(GGally, quietly = TRUE)
data(tips)
```


## Bivariate plots

### with 2x continuous variables

#### `ggally_autopoint()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Scatterplot of tip versus total bill. Tips rise with the bill.",
#|     "Scatterplot of tip versus total bill, coloured by time (dinner or lunch). Tips rise with the bill at both meals."
#|   )
ggally_autopoint(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip))
ggally_autopoint(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_cor()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Text panel showing the correlation between total bill and tip: Corr 0.676 with three significance stars.",
#|     "Text panel showing the overall correlation between total bill and tip (0.676), then the dinner (0.633) and lunch (0.805) correlations in their own colours."
#|   )
ggally_cor(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip))
ggally_cor(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip, colour = time))
```

See also `ggally_statistic()`.

#### `ggally_density()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "2D density contour plot of tip versus total bill. Most bills sit near 15 dollars with tips near 2 dollars.",
#|     "2D density contour plot of tip versus total bill, with separate contours coloured by time. Lunch contours sit at slightly lower bills than dinner."
#|   )
ggally_density(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip))
ggally_density(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_points()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Scatterplot of tip versus total bill. Tips rise with the bill.",
#|     "Scatterplot of tip versus total bill, coloured by time. Tips rise with the bill at both meals."
#|   )
ggally_points(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip))
ggally_points(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip, colour = time))
```


#### `ggally_smooth()`, `ggally_smooth_lm()` & `ggally_smooth_loess()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Scatterplot of tip versus total bill with a straight linear fit and confidence band. The line slopes upward.",
#|     "Scatterplot of tip versus total bill coloured by time, with a separate linear fit for dinner and lunch. Both lines slope upward.",
#|     "Scatterplot of tip versus total bill with a curved loess fit and confidence band. The curve rises with the bill.",
#|     "Scatterplot of tip versus total bill coloured by time, with a separate loess curve for dinner and lunch. Both curves rise with the bill."
#|   )
ggally_smooth_lm(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip))
ggally_smooth_lm(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip, colour = time))

ggally_smooth_loess(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip))
ggally_smooth_loess(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = tip, colour = time))
```

See also `ggally_smooth()` for more options.

### with 2x discrete variables

#### `ggally_colbar()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: >
#|   Stacked bar chart of the percentage of smokers and non-smokers within each day, with percent labels. Friday has the most smokers (79 percent); Sunday and Thursday have the fewest.
ggally_colbar(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
```

Note: the **colour** aesthetic is not taken into account.

#### `ggally_autopoint()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Jittered point plot of smoker versus day. Each point is one bill, and the clouds show how many bills fall in each day and smoker pair.",
#|     "Jittered point plot of smoker versus day, coloured by time. Thursday is almost all lunch, while Saturday and Sunday are all dinner."
#|   )
ggally_autopoint(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
ggally_autopoint(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = time))
```


#### `ggally_count()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Grid of grey rectangles for smoker versus day, sized by the number of bills. Friday non-smokers is the smallest cell.",
#|     "Grid of rectangles for smoker versus day, sized by the number of bills and filled by time. Thursday is mostly lunch and the weekend is all dinner."
#|   )
ggally_count(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
ggally_count(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_cross()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Cross plot of smoker versus day with squares sized by the observed count. Friday non-smokers is the smallest square.",
#|     "The same cross plot of smoker versus day; colouring by time is ignored, so it looks identical to the first.",
#|     "Cross plot of smoker versus day with squares sized by count and coloured by smoker."
#|   )
ggally_cross(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
ggally_cross(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = time))
ggally_cross(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = smoker))
```

Note: **colour** aesthetic is taken into account only if it corresponds to **x** or to **y**.

#### `ggally_crosstable()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Table of counts of smoker versus day, with one number per cell. Sunday non-smokers is the largest count (57) and Friday non-smokers the smallest (4).",
#|     "Table of column percentages of smoker versus day, with cells filled by standardized residuals. Friday smokers are much more common than expected; Sunday and Thursday smokers are less common."
#|   )
ggally_crosstable(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
ggally_crosstable(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker), cells = "col.prop", fill = "std.resid")
```

Note: **colour** aesthetic is not taken into account.

#### `ggally_facetbar()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Bar charts of bill counts by day, in one facet per smoker status. Non-smokers peak on Sunday; smokers peak on Saturday.",
#|     "Bar charts of bill counts by day in one facet per smoker status, with bars stacked by time. Thursday bars are almost all lunch and weekend bars are all dinner."
#|   )
ggally_facetbar(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
ggally_facetbar(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_ratio()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Mosaic plot of smoker versus day where each rectangle's area shows the number of bills. Saturday and Sunday have the largest areas.",
#|     "The same mosaic plot of smoker versus day; colouring by time is ignored."
#|   )
ggally_ratio(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
ggally_ratio(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_rowbar()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: >
#|   Stacked horizontal bar chart of the percentage of each day within each smoker group, with percent labels. Saturday is the largest share among smokers (45 percent); Sunday is the largest among non-smokers.
ggally_rowbar(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
```

Note: the **colour** aesthetic is not taken into account.

#### `ggally_table()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Table of counts of smoker versus day, shown as numbers at each day and smoker position.",
#|     "The same table of counts of smoker versus day; colouring by time is ignored.",
#|     "Table of counts of smoker versus day, with numbers coloured by smoker."
#|   )
ggally_table(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
ggally_table(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = time))
ggally_table(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = smoker))
```

Note: **colour** aesthetic is taken into account only if it corresponds to **x** or to **y**.

#### `ggally_trends()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Line chart of the share of smokers by day. It drops from about 79 percent on Friday to about 25 percent on Sunday.",
#|     "Line chart of the share of smokers by day, with one line per time (dinner or lunch). Both lines fall from Friday to Thursday."
#|   )
ggally_trends(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker))
ggally_trends(tips, aes(x = day, y = smoker, colour = time))
```

### with 1x continuous and 1x discrete variables


#### `ggally_autopoint()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Jittered point plot of day versus total bill. Each day spreads from about 5 to 50 dollars, with most bills between 10 and 25.",
#|     "Jittered point plot of day versus total bill, coloured by time. Thursday is almost all lunch and the weekend is all dinner."
#|   )
ggally_autopoint(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_autopoint(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = time))
```


#### `ggally_box()` & `ggally_box_no_facet()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Horizontal boxplots of total bill, one facet per day. Sunday has the highest median bill and Friday the lowest.",
#|     "Horizontal boxplots of total bill, one facet per day, split and filled by time. Lunch bills are lower than dinner bills.",
#|     "Horizontal boxplots of total bill for each day on one shared panel. Sunday has the highest median bill.",
#|     "Horizontal boxplots of total bill for each day on one shared panel, split and filled by time. Lunch bills are lower than dinner bills."
#|   )
ggally_box(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_box(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = time))
ggally_box_no_facet(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_box_no_facet(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_denstrip()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Density strips of total bill, one facet per day, where lighter blue tiles mark denser ranges. Bills cluster between 10 and 25 dollars.",
#|     "The same density strips of total bill by day; colouring by time is ignored."
#|   )
ggally_denstrip(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_denstrip(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_dot()` & `ggally_dot_no_facet()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Jittered dot plot of total bill, one facet per day. Bills cluster between 10 and 25 dollars on every day.",
#|     "Jittered dot plot of total bill, one facet per day, coloured by time. Thursday is almost all lunch and the weekend is all dinner.",
#|     "Jittered dot plot of day versus total bill on one shared panel. Bills cluster between 10 and 25 dollars on every day.",
#|     "Jittered dot plot of day versus total bill on one shared panel, coloured by time."
#|   )
ggally_dot(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_dot(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = time))
ggally_dot_no_facet(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_dot_no_facet(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_facetdensitystrip()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Density curves of total bill, one facet per day. Each curve peaks around 13 to 18 dollars with a long right tail.",
#|     "Density curves of total bill, one facet per day, with one curve per time. Friday lunch bills are tightly grouped around 13 dollars."
#|   )
ggally_facetdensitystrip(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_facetdensitystrip(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_facethist()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Histograms of total bill, one facet per day. Saturday and Sunday have the most bills, Friday the fewest.",
#|     "Histograms of total bill, one facet per day, with bars stacked by time. Thursday is almost all lunch and the weekend is all dinner."
#|   )
ggally_facethist(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_facethist(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_summarise_by()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Text panel listing the median total bill and interquartile range for each day. Sunday has the highest median (19.6) and Friday the lowest (15.4).",
#|     "The same median and interquartile range text for each day, with each day's text in its own colour."
#|   )
ggally_summarise_by(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day))
ggally_summarise_by(tips, aes(x = total_bill, y = day, colour = day))
```

Note: colour aesthetic is kept only if corresponding to the discrete axis.

#### `ggally_trends()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Line chart of mean total bill by day. It rises from about 17 dollars on Friday to about 21 on Sunday, then drops on Thursday.",
#|     "Line chart of mean total bill by day, with one line per time. Dinner bills are higher than lunch bills on every day."
#|   )
ggally_trends(tips, aes(y = total_bill, x = day))
ggally_trends(tips, aes(y = total_bill, x = day, colour = time))
```

## Diagonal plots

### with 1x continuous variable


#### `ggally_autopointDiag()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Points of total bill plotted against itself, forming a straight diagonal line.",
#|     "Points of total bill plotted against itself, forming a straight diagonal line, coloured by time."
#|   )
ggally_autopointDiag(tips, aes(x = total_bill))
ggally_autopointDiag(tips, aes(x = total_bill, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_barDiag()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Histogram of total bill. It is right skewed, with most bills between 10 and 25 dollars.",
#|     "Histogram of total bill with bars stacked by time. Lunch bills sit at the lower end."
#|   )
ggally_barDiag(tips, aes(x = total_bill))
ggally_barDiag(tips, aes(x = total_bill, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_densityDiag()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Density curve of total bill. It peaks near 16 dollars and has a long right tail.",
#|     "Density curves of total bill filled by time. The lunch curve peaks at a lower bill and is narrower than dinner."
#|   )
ggally_densityDiag(tips, aes(x = total_bill))
ggally_densityDiag(tips, aes(x = total_bill, colour = time))
```

### with 1x discrete variable

#### `ggally_autopointDiag()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Jittered point clouds of day against itself, placed along the diagonal. Saturday and Sunday have the largest clouds, Friday the smallest.",
#|     "Jittered point clouds of day against itself along the diagonal, coloured by time. Thursday is lunch and the weekend is dinner."
#|   )
ggally_autopointDiag(tips, aes(x = day))
ggally_autopointDiag(tips, aes(x = day, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_barDiag()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Bar chart of bill counts by day. Saturday has the most bills and Friday the fewest.",
#|     "Bar chart of bill counts by day, stacked by time. Thursday is almost all lunch and the weekend is all dinner."
#|   )
ggally_barDiag(tips, aes(x = day))
ggally_barDiag(tips, aes(x = day, colour = time))
```

#### `ggally_countDiag()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Grey squares of day against itself along the diagonal, sized by count. Saturday is the largest and Friday the smallest.",
#|     "Squares of day against itself along the diagonal, sized by count and filled by time. Thursday is lunch and the weekend is dinner."
#|   )
ggally_countDiag(tips, aes(x = day))
ggally_countDiag(tips, aes(x = day, colour = time))
```


#### `ggally_densityDiag()`

```{r}
#| fig.alt: !expr |
#|   c(
#|     "Density curves drawn over the day categories, one curve per day, each peaking at its own day.",
#|     "Density curves over the day categories, stacked and filled by time. Lunch dominates Friday and Thursday, dinner dominates Saturday and Sunday."
#|   )
ggally_densityDiag(tips, aes(x = day))
ggally_densityDiag(tips, aes(x = day, colour = time))
```

## Additional plots

- `ggally_statistic()` and `ggally_text()` to display custom text
- `ggally_blank()` and `ggally_blankDiag()` for blank plot
- `ggally_na()` and `ggally_naDiag()` to display a large `NA`
